children: Upside inflation risks have increased recently and, if those are confirmed in the European Central Bank's next forecast, an interest rate increase will be needed quickly, ECB policymaker Martin Kocher said on Tuesday.

"In the euro area as a whole, upside risks to inflation have also increased again recently," he said in a statement in response to monthly inflation data. "If this picture is confirmed in the ECB's next forecast, I believe another interest rate increase will be necessary soon."
